verdict.rationale: LiteLLM has an official, first-party documented CLI at docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/cli, confirmed by a probe. The docs show it launches the proxy with server options such as the uvicorn/gunicorn/Granian --workers flag. Missing for 10: evidence that the CLI goes beyond launching the proxy (e.g. managing keys, models or requests from the terminal), machine-readable or agent-friendly output modes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage.
